paragraphs: Manage My Market sells online software for running farmers markets, described on the site as a solution designed to simplify vendor management for farmers market operators. The company is based in Portland, Oregon. The site dates the work with market managers to 2003, and says the platform began when a market manager teamed up with a developer.

The platform covers vendor application processing, stall assignments, accounting, analytics, interactive maps, and product search. Market managers approve vendors, assign stalls, enter sales and payments, send invoices, track licenses, send emails, and run reports. Accounting records PayPal, Square, and Stripe transactions automatically, and license reporting flags vendors with missing, expired or current licenses.

Vendors create a company profile, upload licenses and other documentation, and apply to markets in their area. The site says farmers markets across all 50 states, as well as in Canada, the UK, and Australia, are supported.

quote.text: Everything you need to efficiently manage your market in one secure place.
